text:
Maria J.: Hey partners — handing off the QuickPulse deploy kit for the new marketplace onramp. attaching the minimal checklist and a tiny terraform snippet for the reference arch. please review and call out blockers. :spiral_notepad:

Ajay P.: Thanks — quick read looks good. can we confirm the public modules are pinned to tags (no floating refs)?

Carmen L.: Yep, all modules are tagged. I pushed v0.3.1 to the partner repo this morning.

Maria J.: @Carmen L. great. Ajay, snippet we plan to share in the partner doc: (keeps infra minimal for initial deploy)

marketplace-ci-bot: CI pipeline triggered for repo: redwood/partner-onramp (build 142) :white_check_mark:

Maria J.: ```hcl
module "redwood_onramp" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/partner-onramp.git//modules/basic?ref=v0.3.1"
  region = var.region
  node_pool = { size = 2, type = "g4dn.xlarge" }
}
```

kevin_sre: Couple of ops notes:
- Add an S3 bucket policy example for telemetry bucket (we can't grant public access)
- Recommend adding a simple IAM role mapping for partner CI service account

Ajay P.: For the S3 policy I'll paste a short example to include in the docs. also we should add a note about getting quota uplift — partners often hit defaults on first run.

Carmen L.: Can someone own the on-call doc link? I can add the runbook snippets but need the contact rota to embed.

Maria J.: @kevin_sre can you own the runbook contact list? I'll update the refkit README to include the CI badges and quickstart commands.

kevin_sre: I got it. i'll add the oncall rota and a short troubleshooting section (KV cache warmup, model fallback) by EOD tomorrow.

Ajay P.: Small UX ask — include a one-liner for partners: "how to validate a successful deploy" (curl health endpoint + expected 200 + example json). keeps support volume down.

Maria J.: Good call. I'll add: `curl -sS https://<deploy>.redwood-partner.io/health | jq .status` expected: "ok"

marketplace-ci-bot: Deployment preview available: https://preview.builds.redwood/partner-onramp/142 :rocket:

Carmen L.: I tested the preview yaml and the terraform extra vars work (region, billing_project). see my comment in PR #238.

Maria J.: Action items: 1) kevin — runbook/rota, 2) Ajay — S3 policy + quota note, 3) Carmen — finalize README PR, 4) Maria — publish partner-facing quickstart doc and share marketing-ready blurb for announcements.

kevin_sre: I'll also add a short snippet for enabling private endpoint (VPC peering note) — partners in regulated industries asked for it.

Ajay P.: ETA on docs updates?

Carmen L.: I'll merge README PR after a quick lgtm from Ajay today.

Maria J.: Let's aim to publish the QuickPulse Onramp kit by end of this week. If anything blocks that timeline ping here and escalate to partnerships-splits. thanks team! :raised_hands:
